$Comment: A normal daily: a proper order of gear taken apart at a Disenchanting Table. STATION_INPUT counts a piece the moment a table consumes it, so a stocked chest cannot fill it; the blank Target matches every item, and the step carries the shared unmake_gear TextKey since the kind's default line names a single item. Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table' with QualifierMatchMode PREFIX counts both tables and never the Sawmill. Weight 2 makes it twice as likely as an even rival for the same normal slot. This file spells out its whole step and pay rather than inheriting a shared skeleton, so it loads with nothing but this pack, RPG Stations and the MMO installed; it hangs on the Daily board by id, and on a server with no board of that id it is simply never posted. The stations feature condition in Requires hides the contract rather than locking it: it is lifted out of the gate when the contract loads and the board's draw reads it live, so on a server where stations have been switched off the contract never takes a slot and is never posted, rather than being offered and refused at Accept.
